validation.deduplication: actual rollout_id plus canonical game/state/physical group, never branch count
validation.scope: Portable accepted evidence joins; no new environment execution or full production re-audit

paths.interpretation: D0 r=1 development paths. Repetitions and no-op feedback are observed behavior, not established causes. Observed Y differences do not identify true conditional utility; D checks do not replace separate N/P replay.

physical_group_timings.scope: 117 accepted physical groups; excludes old interrupted/invalidated fragments; not whole-runner or job wall time
physical_group_timings.overlap_note: Recovery total_s is restore wall plus cleanup; build_reset_s contains build_s and reset_s. These components overlap, and rollout elapsed overlaps recovery and model requests. Do not add them.

whole_runner_wall.reason: No complete whole-runner timing input across accepted, resumed and stopped attempts; group elapsed and allocation are separate quantities.

limitations: Current campaign only; excludes earlier diagnostics, campaigns and smoke jobs.
Every exported row comes from an actual request_start; charged reservation totals are not expanded into rows.
Stopped-attempt recorded starts can omit other unrecorded calls; counts_complete=false never means actual total is known.
943125 has zero recorded calls in final accounting but its stage original was not located in the fixed archive map; no empty audit is invented.
Source 934277/934493 backend reports have matching self seals and audit artifact hashes; final accounting binds stage results, not these reports directly.
Missing HTTP/usage/terminal fields remain unknown; known subtotals include failed attempts where preserved.

The orphan 935310 request start is retained in cost rows and excluded from accepted physical-group calls. Starts and accepted accounting logical-call counters differ by one; neither value overwrites the other.
Rollout/recovery timings cover the 117 accepted physical groups only. Whole-runner time across accepted, resumed and stopped attempts is not exported; group elapsed is not runner/job wall time.
No wall-time addition across request, attempt, rollout and allocation; no monetary price or GPU busy-time inference.

counter_reconciliation.935310: Original audits contain 278 unique request_start records, 277 terminal records and 277 HTTP attempt records. Final accounting retains 277 recorded logical calls and 279 observed http_attempts_charged. The extra start has no terminal/HTTP-attempt record; its actual HTTP count, usage and outcome are unknown. The two-unit HTTP charge difference is conservative accounting, not evidence of two actual HTTP requests.
counter_reconciliation.campaign: Across 15 attempts: 2200 original request starts, 2199 terminals and 2199 saved HTTP attempts, versus accepted accounting counters of 2199 recorded logical calls and 2201 observed http_attempts_charged. The ledger is unchanged. Counts from incomplete attempts remain lower-coverage observations, not a complete campaign actual-cost total.
counter_reconciliation.request_start_semantics: A start records entry into an attempted logical model call, not proof of an HTTP request reaching the server. A missing terminal's zero saved attempts is missing evidence, not zero actual HTTP cost.

costs.timing_note: Request time, attempt time, rollout time and allocation overlap; do not add them. Charged allocation is a conservative budget charge, not measured GPU busy time.

inventory_metadata.evidence_scope: Accepted source r=1 paths and actual continuation ledger IDs; selection is not a replay receipt

protocol.new_mu_definition: new continuation logical requests including terminal policy failure; excludes cached draft, first-action generation, HTTP retries

np_candidates.evidence_binding_contract: Archive adapter and CLI verify files and frozen events; selector validates basic schema and retains opaque bindings
np_candidates.incomplete_collection_policy: No executable selection from a completed subset; retain missing and excluded evidence
